Final rebar-debug report after Gerrit 1811 merged as 8f9e40efcc742bcbb616930503dc555ba8f4dc20.

Problem — repeated full-checkout package builds in cross-platform provenance semantics tests consumed avoidable runner time, while the full artifact probe accepted a wrong but nonempty trusted-main SHA on Gerrit patchsets.

Proven root cause — whole-tree fixture helpers exported all 3,019 checkout files although production hatch_build.py consumes only its own hook file, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py before generating _build_info.py. Xdist runtime tracing proved the session fixture initialized independently on all three workers. Separately, _artifact-probe.yml used workflow GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving the final checked-out HEAD and asserted truthiness rather than exact identity.

Proof — the unchanged production hook on a three-file real Hatch package preserved env override, Git fallback, blank-env failure, sdist preservation, shallow-source, and direct full-wheel behavior. Exact selected-six serial elapsed fell from 18.23s to 9.11s (50.0%); per-worker setup fell from 6.60–6.74s to 2.20–2.88s (56–67%). Hosted artifact-probe run 31883105646 built wheel and sdist from patchset 8f9e40ef and both exact-SHA probes passed in a 47s job.

RED→GREEN tests — held-out tests/unit/test_build_provenance_fixture_scale.py and tests/unit/test_artifact_probe_workflow.py were 3/3 RED before repair and 3/3 GREEN after. Restoring the 3,019-file fixture, restoring GITHUB_SHA plus truthiness probes, and deleting preserve-existing precedence each returned the appropriate oracle to RED; every mutation was restored. Focused changed tests passed 38; workflow consumers passed 250; full local default passed 13,449/17 skipped; full local integration passed 167/2 skipped; make lint and make typecheck passed.

Fix — tests/_build_provenance_fixture.py now builds a minimal committed package through the copied production hook and real isolated PEP 517 sdist→wheel boundary in every existing OS/Python cell. _artifact-probe.yml derives git rev-parse --short HEAD after the final lane-specific checkout and requires exact wheel and sdist equality. No build is mocked.

Hosted replication — Gerrit Verify run 31883105646 succeeded from 11:51:19Z to 12:12:46Z, 21m27s end-to-end. All matrix cells began together at 11:52:47–48Z after 88–89s of prerequisite routing/gating, with no relative runner queue. Job/default/integration results: Ubuntu 3.11 6m26s / 269.82s / 55.82s (13,402/64 and 158/11); Ubuntu 3.12 10m37s / 479.62s / 90.61s; Ubuntu 3.13+coverage 13m19s / 649.91s / 83.43s; macOS 19m45s / 999.20s / 104.84s (13,401/65 and 158/11). The macOS default was 16m39s pytest, versus the exact earlier 17m26s no-RAM control; this single hosted sample confirms no regression but is not an average claim.

Over-30s attribution — no individual test exceeded 30s on any cell. The only test over 20s was macOS integration test_benchmark_commit_count_is_ceil_per_pass at 21.43s; the slowest macOS default call was 13.20s. Workflow operations over 30s were: macOS default 1001s; Ubuntu 3.13 default 652s; Ubuntu 3.12 default 482s; Ubuntu 3.11 default 272s; macOS integration 106s; Ubuntu 3.12 integration 91s; Ubuntu 3.13 integration 84s; optional-extras installs 75s; complexity-baseline lock 59s; Ubuntu 3.11 integration 56s; whole-store identity mount 48s.

Scope and safety — every selector, marker, assertion, isolation boundary, worker/distribution count, timeout, OS/Python cell, coverage gate, mutation gate, runner, and vote dependency remains. No dependency was added and no test was weakened. OSS placement remains 4/4 consensus across pytest, pip, Poetry, and Pydantic; rebar is stricter because every matrix cell retains a real minimal PEP 517 replay.

Siblings — the artifact-probe wrong-SHA sibling was fixed in scope for both branch-head and Gerrit lanes. String sweep found no remaining whole-checkout archive/tar fixture in build-hook semantics tests.

Residual risk — one 21m27s run is inside the 20–30m target but cannot prove the average. Organic-run sampling remains on inedible-subsimious-brahmancow. The 21.43s import benchmark remains tracked by ravenous-beribboned-walleye. No other undispositioned fragility was observed.

Gates — LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and successful Submit were confirmed before merge.
